temporary_binary_namespace.reason: Runtime binary, datadir, config-file, and artifact-name migration is intentionally deferred to a separate release step.

production_blockers.description: Publish and independently verify the zkCoin binary release signing key fingerprint.
Choose and document the zkCoin Gitian signatures repository and signer quorum.
Choose and document the zkCoin detached-signatures repository for Windows and macOS signing payloads.
Choose the zkCoin artifact distribution host and checksum publication path.
Decide whether the first production release keeps litecoin-* binary/artifact names or migrates to zkcoin-* names.
Choose macOS bundle identifiers, signing certificate policy, and notarization ownership.
Choose Windows signing key custody and detached-signature workflow.

current_inherited_release_surfaces.reason: Windows signer descriptor still uses Litecoin detached signatures.
macOS signer descriptor still uses Litecoin detached signatures.
Source archive names still use the temporary Litecoin compatibility namespace.
Release process still contains inherited Litecoin signing and distribution instructions and must stay marked blocked.
Automated Gitian helper is inherited from Bitcoin Core and must not be used for zkCoin releases.
Legacy Bitcoin Core verification helper remains guarded for upstream-reference use only; zkCoin verification uses verify-zkcoin-release.py.
Autotools tarname intentionally remains litecoin until binary/artifact migration is decided.
MSVC tarname intentionally remains litecoin until binary/artifact migration is decided.

notes: Do not treat Gitian, signing, notarization, upload, or binary verification instructions as production zkCoin release instructions while status is release_infrastructure_not_ready.
The source release-candidate validation gate proves source tarball real-proof readiness only; it is not binary release readiness and does not authorize publishing artifacts.
Gitian source descriptors fetch zk-coin/zkcoin while retaining the litecoin input directory name until binary and artifact namespace migration is decided.
zkCoin binary artifact verification is parameterized through contrib/verifybinaries/verify-zkcoin-release.py; production signing keys and artifact hosts remain separate release blockers.
When a blocker is resolved, update this manifest and the release lint in the same PR.
